TestEmailSnoozeCRUD.test_snooze_replaces_existing_snooze: PASS - Snoozing same message_id replaces existing

TestScheduledEmailCRUD.test_schedule_email_and_verify_persisten: PASS - Scheduled email persists with status=pending

TestEmailTrackingCRUD.test_create_tracking_and_verify_persiste: PASS - Tracking persists with initial counts=0

features_verified: 1. Snooze API - POST /api/email-features/snooze - snoozes email until specified time
2. Snooze API - GET /api/email-features/snoozed - lists user's snoozed emails (future snooze_until only)
3. Snooze API - DELETE /api/email-features/snooze/{message_id} - unsnoozes email
4. Snooze replaces existing - same message_id overwrites previous snooze
5. Scheduled Send API - POST /api/email-features/scheduled - schedules email for later
6. Scheduled Send API - GET /api/email-features/scheduled - lists pending scheduled emails
7. Scheduled Send API - DELETE /api/email-features/scheduled/{id} - cancels scheduled email
8. Scheduled emails have status field (pending/sent/cancelled/failed)
9. Follow-up Reminders API - POST /api/email-features/follow-ups - creates follow-up reminder
10. Follow-up Reminders API - GET /api/email-features/follow-ups - lists active reminders
11. Follow-up Reminders API - PUT /api/email-features/follow-ups/{id}/dismiss - dismisses reminder
12. Follow-up Reminders API - PUT /api/email-features/follow-ups/{id}/snooze?hours=N - snoozes reminder
13. Follow-up remind_at is auto-calculated from remind_after_hours (default 48)
14. Email Tracking API - POST /api/email-features/tracking - creates tracking record
15. Email Tracking API - GET /api/email-features/tracking - lists tracking records
16. Email Tracking API - GET /api/email-features/track/{id}/pixel.gif - returns 1x1 transparent GIF
17. Tracking pixel is PUBLIC endpoint (no auth required) - used in email clients
18. Tracking pixel increments open_count and sets first_opened_at/last_opened_at
19. Email Tracking API - GET /api/email-features/tracking/stats/summary - returns aggregate stats
20. Stats include: total_emails_tracked, total_opens, total_clicks, open_rate, click_rate
21. Stats support custom period via ?days=N parameter (default 30, max 90)
22. All authenticated endpoints require valid Bearer token (return 401/403 without)
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Features API Phase 2 & 3 fully functional. MongoDB collections: snoozed_emails, scheduled_emails, email_follow_ups, email_tracking, email_tracking_events. Key behaviors: 1) Snooze replaces existing snooze for same message_id, 2) Scheduled emails use status field (pending->cancelled when deleted), 3) Follow-ups calculate remind_at from remind_after_hours, 4) Tracking pixel is PUBLIC (no auth) and increments counts on each request, 5) Stats summary aggregates data over configurable period. Frontend (EmailPage.jsx) has corresponding functions: snoozeEmailAction, fetchSnoozedEmails, scheduleEmail, cancelScheduledEmail, createFollowUp, dismissFollowUp, snoozeFollowUp, createTracking, fetchTrackingStats. Note: Frontend cannot be tested due to Microsoft OAuth requirement.
